title: Agent Passport rule pack, B2B payment initiation (APS 1001 revision 3, bank-first)
jurisdiction: United Kingdom (proposed industry standard; no current legal requirement)

policy.ceilings_note: Agent-channel ceilings: the account type sets the product ceiling, the provider's assurance level scales the bank's admission ceiling, and every mandate must sit at or below the lower of the two. Containment is checked when the customer signs.
policy.review_note: No instruction is refused outright. A check that fails holds the instruction for a person: the instruction is not executed, the failed check and its class are recorded as the reason for review, and a named person approves or declines it with a written note. Both outcomes are receipted chain entries.

pattern_threshold.note: the same rule refused this many times within the window on one passport raises an alert to the bank's payments risk team

assurance_levels.label: Self-declared
assurance_levels.note: the provider's own statement; no independent evidence attached

assurance_levels.label: Independently verified
assurance_levels.note: a named independent party has checked the documentation against the product

assurance_levels.label: Independently audited
assurance_levels.note: a named independent party has tested the product against the minimum assurance requirements for the use case

chain_rules.title: Root mandate scope is well formed
Delegation is a subset of the root mandate
chain_rules.source: Delegation signed by the orchestrator key in agent_identity.cnf; beneficiaries, ceiling, actions, validity ⊆ root

chain_rules.title: Action lies inside the narrowest scope
chain_rules.source: Instruction signed by the delegated execution key named in the delegation

registration_rules.title: Provider resolves at Companies House
registration_rules.source: Companies House public register (live lookup, or the synthetic demo register when offline). Companies House reports what companies filed; it verifies nothing itself

registration_rules.title: Accountable principal named, with a signed declaration
registration_rules.source: Filing declaration, as for a Companies House filing; accountability for the filing, not a quality judgement

registration_rules.title: Insurance evidenced, cover at or above the minimum, in force
registration_rules.source: Professional indemnity policy summary; minimum cover in the policy table

registration_rules.title: AI product documented with a pinned model version
registration_rules.source: Filing form: product name, identifier, release, foundation model provider and pinned version, documentation location

registration_rules.title: Independent Assurance Evidence attached, with its assurance level, covering the registered use case
registration_rules.source: Independent benchmark or audit report and a declared assurance level (self-declared, independently verified, independently audited). Presence, level and scope are checked; the register makes no quality judgement

registration_rules.title: Product not already on the register
UK data protection declared: UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018 compliance, ICO registration, personal data retention period
registration_rules.source: Provider declaration signed for by the accountable principal; ICO register of fee payers (format of the registration number only). The register verifies nothing about compliance

runtime_rules.title: Passport active and unexpired (bank's list lookup)
Agent identity signature genuine (customer key), bound to this admission
Instruction signed by the AI agent key inside agent_identity, with a nonce not seen before
Mandate signed by the customer, unexpired, not revoked
Action and currency permitted, payee account on the customer-signed allowlist
Cumulative limits: 30-day total for this payee account and payments per rolling day within the mandate
runtime_rules.source: Mandate monthly_limit_per_account and max_payments_per_day; bank-held ledger (limits in the mandate, totals at the bank)

runtime_rules.title: Bank hold conditions: an amount above hold_above is held for the customer's named approver; the first payment under a mandate version is held for the customer's own confirmation
runtime_rules.source: Admission condition set by the bank's payments risk officer; graduated trust: a person at the mandate, at the first payment, at the threshold, autonomy in between
runtime_rules.data: envelope.admission + instruction + the bank's record of confirmed mandate versions

fraud.label: Fraud indicator
fraud.note: something the customer never authorised: a payee account not on the mandate, an invalid signature, a passport unknown, suspended or revoked, a replayed instruction, a key or record mismatch. For the bank's risk team

agent_error.label: Agent error
agent_error.note: the AI agent's own mistake inside its remit: an amount over a ceiling, a wrong currency or action, velocity exceeded, an expired or unsigned mandate, a malformed instruction. A quality signal for its owner, not a report to anyone

planned_fields.note: attenuation from user to agent to sub-agent, each hop only narrowing authority (S_action ⊆ S_n ⊆ … ⊆ S_0); the demo carries an optional prototype behind a switch
the hold-for-a-person amount as a first-class passport field the customer can tighten, rather than only the bank's admission condition

payment_intents.label: Pay supplier invoices
payment_intents.description: settle invoices from suppliers on the customer's allow-list

payment_intents.label: Pay salaries and contractors
payment_intents.description: payroll runs to named employee and contractor accounts

payment_intents.label: Pay recurring subscriptions
payment_intents.description: recurring charges to named service providers

payment_intents.label: Refund customers
payment_intents.description: return money to a customer's own account

payment_intents.label: Top up cards and wallets
payment_intents.description: fund a card or wallet the customer controls
